justification: Both are upright commemorative slabs with a bordered field, and both include small profile figures plus repeated linear border ornament, but this is generic to monument-making. A shows crowded human figures in elaborate costume with columns of dense script-like signs, while B is dominated by a large whirling multi-armed rosette ringed by a border of discs, flanked by tiny schematic quadrupeds and wave/spiral bands — no specific motif, posture or combination is shared.
